attack_techniques: Command and Scripting Interpreter: AutoHotKey & AutoIT (T1059.010)
Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell (T1059.003)
attackers_goals: Gain code execution on the host and evade security controls.
description: AutoIT scripts have legitimate uses but are often abused by malware to execute in a signed process context.
investigative_actions: Check whether the command line executed is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Check whether the user from the command line is an administrator or other sensitive account.
name: Commonly abused AutoIT script drops an executable file to disk
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
